body_markdown:
BW LPG participated in Pareto Securities’ 33rd Annual Energy Conference in Oslo on 17 September 2026. CEO Kristian Sørensen delivered a company presentation and met with investors during a series of one-to-one discussions.


The presentation focused on VLGC freight rates, LPG market volatility and BW LPG’s approach to managing market risk. VLGC spot rates had reached approximately US$200,000 per day, driven by market inefficiencies following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and increased Panama Canal traffic. These developments resulted in longer sailing distances and reduced vessel availability.


Kristian also outlined how BW LPG continues to navigate market volatility while maintaining its long-term strategy. This includes securing attractive time-charter coverage and competitive financing for the company’s fleet renewal programme, while retaining exposure to the strong spot market. Looking ahead, the development of global trade flows will be an important factor in determining how the VLGC orderbook is absorbed over the coming years.


BW LPG thanks the investors who met with the team during the conference for their continued interest and engagement.


**View the full presentation:**[BW LPG – 2026 Pareto Energy Conference](https://www.bwlpg.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/BW-LPG-2026-Pareto-Energy-Conference_PPT.pdf)
